notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Changes in 1.1.4:


 Slightly altered backgrounds.
 Added missing animations for buttons in focus.
 Further improved window placement upon game start.
 Upgraded game engine.


Changes in 1.1.4.1:


 Improve awareness about special keys, such as volume up/down, and avoid qualifying them as "any key".

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Bugfix update!

Changes in 1.1.2:

 The game now remembers one's window position and restores it during the next playing session if played in windowed mode. This also should prevent game window caption from being hidden behind Windows taskbar, if it is placed on the top edge of the screen.
 Fixed a minor visual glitch, which probably no one noticed anyway. It was related to brightness of 2x2 gem blocks when they are split back into small ones to give way for Options menu or Match Results popup.


My thanks for reporting issues!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1: Alternative Tileset
notes.notes:
This update adds a slightly different gem presentation mode
The mode is activated and deactivated via a button on Esc menu. When it is on, small symbols are drawn on top of free gems, providing additional means of differentiating them.

notes.title: Major Update 1.1.0: Arenas and More
Upcoming major update (and price increase)
notes.notes:
What Gem Master needs is more variety!

Therefore, I would like to announce that I am working on a major update to the game, which will introduce different "arenas" for matches to be played on, among other improvements.
Instead of the same plain field each time, fields will now feature walls and obstacles, creating additional strategic opportunities or pitfalls.

However, that comes together with a decision to increase the price of the game. Of course, the existing players will not be affected; if you own Gem Master by that time, you will just receive the update for free.

The update is planned to go live in September.

Bugfix update!

That's it for today! Thank you!
